HEARING on 'The Year Against Racism 1997: an interim appraisal' - Experts invited: - Jean KAHN, chairman of the Consultative Committee on Racism and Xenophobia set up by the European Council, France - William DUNCAN, Professor, Trinity College, Dublin, Ireland - Henk MOLLEMAN, Dutch Presidency of the Council of Ministers, chairman of the Working Party on the Monitoring Centre for Racism - Annette BOSSCHER, Head of Division, Commission, Brussels - Said CHARCHIERA, President of the European Union Migrants Forum, Brussels - (about 9 a.m. to 12.30 p.m.)
